{{Top|leg}}
'''Taurannix chapbooks''' were valuable items that, according to rumors, were among other relics from across the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] once possessed by the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]]. All such items were believed to contain inherent [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side power]] and could have been sold for thousands of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to collectors in civilized space.

==Behind the scenes==
It was never confirmed whether there had been any connection between the chapbooks and the [[Taurannik Codex]], but even if there had been one, it was difficult to say whether the word «Taurannix» had not simply been a misspelling of «Taurannik».
